title: Private same-guest response custody process inspection
$comment: Closed data grammar only, not a verdict, quote, release permission or readiness. Canonical UTF8 sorted JSON without LF: bootstrap <=16384 bytes, IPC <=4096 bytes. Actual descriptors, parent/child ownership, signed cold config/delivery, kernel boot, capabilities, finite original deadlines, local context equality and sequences are independently enforced by the source owners. No public RPC or caller-selected PID/path target.

ns.$comment: Actual parser also requires <=u64::MAX, exact decimal spelling, positive and original absolute CLOCK_BOOTTIME deadline.

path.$comment: Source bounds UTF8 bytes, rejects empty/dot/dotdot components; paths occur only in cold bootstrap, never inspection requests.

bootstrap.$comment: FD5 actual sealed memfd root:root0600/nlink0. All four immutable seals; exact signed config/delivery admission and actual parent channel required. Gate lifetime is supplied only by the original source-owned parent, not made authoritative by these unsigned bytes.

request.$comment: Channel sequence starts1 and advances exactly once, never reconnects/resets. Connection SCM_RIGHTS exact2 accepted socket/connection PIDFD; packet exact3 additionally actual SCM_PIDFD of gate packet. Router supplies its actual local retained frame/session/packet context; digest is not a measurement input or independent proof of transmission.

measurement.$comment: Actual shared kernel capture result. Process digest commits retained PIDFD namespace PID list, proc directory device/inode and process start ticks under a distinct fixed domain; no numeric target or descriptors are returned. Receiver still compares independently admitted executable/cgroup/label pins.

initialized.$comment: Private FD3 consistency only, emitted after actual final inspector UID/capability/seccomp checks. Parent must receive genuine SCM_CREDENTIALS and SCM_PIDFD and compare with its retained actual child; this is not cohort readiness.
